title: TEM-STEM Studies of Twisted Epitaxial Ag Nanodisks Encapsulated Between Misoriented MoS2 Bilayers
content: Following the first report of ‘twisted epitaxy’ of gold nanoparticles annealed within twisted MoS2 bilayers [1-3], one natural query arises, which concerns whether this phenomenon occurs for other metal-2D metal dichalcogenide systems. We have first explored this possibility in the Ag-MoS2 system owing to the similarity of the chemical nature and atomic diameter of silver with those of gold. It is indeed now demonstrated here that twisted epitaxy can occur under similar circumstances, which suggests the possibility that it might be a more general phenomenon.
